title: UK power, source to socket: open data
licence: CC BY 4.0 for this compilation. The original sources' terms also apply: NESO Open Data Licence; Elexon BMRS (Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right); OpenStreetMap (ODbL).

datasets.title: Wind turned down, daily
datasets.description: Energy the tracked wind farms were paid to turn down each day (UK days), the payments, and the CO2 if the lost power were replaced by gas at 394 g/kWh.
datasets.source: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right

datasets.title: Wind turned down, by wind farm and day
datasets.description: Each tracked wind farm's daily turn-down, payments and switch-off price, with its support scheme (ro = Renewables Obligation, ic = 2014 investment contract, cfd = auction Contract for Difference, part = CfD on part of the capacity).
datasets.source: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right

datasets.title: Station output, hourly (last 14 days)
datasets.description: Hourly average of each mapped station's physical notification (the output it planned) and the part the grid operator paid it to turn down, in MW, 5 MW resolution.
datasets.source: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right

datasets.title: Carbon intensity, daily
datasets.description: Daily average and lowest carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh, measured where available), hours at or below 50 g, the highest wind and solar shares, and Wales's average wind share.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (Carbon Intensity API)

datasets.title: Weekly summary
datasets.description: One row per Monday-to-Sunday week (UK time): average and extreme carbon intensity, hours at or below 50 g and average generation shares.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (Carbon Intensity API)

datasets.title: Forecast accuracy
datasets.description: How NESO's 24-hour national carbon intensity forecast, saved each morning, compared with the measured figures: mean absolute error, bias, share within 20 g, and how far the forecast's cleanest 3-hour window was from the true cleanest.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (Carbon Intensity API)

datasets.title: Britain's electricity records
datasets.description: All-time records from NESO's historic generation mix (generation-based carbon intensity), since 2009.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (historic generation mix)

datasets.title: Connection queue, by connection site
datasets.description: Capacity with a contract to connect at each transmission connection site (NESO TEC register), repeated rows counted once, with location where the map could place it.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (TEC register); locations © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL

datasets.title: Official constraint costs, with the map's tracked wind payments
datasets.description: NESO's daily constraint costs, alongside the payments to the wind farms this map tracks on the same day. They are not meant to match: NESO's thermal cost includes turning other generators up.
datasets.source: NESO Open Data Licence (constraint breakdown); Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right
